scenarios.name: Retain an arithmetic expression in a model-state parameter

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing length parameter d0
the Primary and Capture State d0 values are 1 in
the user enters "1 in + 0.5 in" in the Copy State d0 cell
accepts and reopens the model-state table
the Copy State d0 cell displays the entered arithmetic expression
the parameter tree displays the active member expression
the Primary and Capture State d0 cells still display 1 in
the user closes the table and opens Parameters
d0 has nominal and model values of 1.5 in
